title: Voice Loom
what: New voices from a written description alone. Each description gives three takes to choose from; the first takes of Bram and Tik were saved and act in later rooms.

inputs.label: Bram
inputs.value: An elderly lighthouse keeper in his seventies with a gravelly, salt-worn voice. Slow, kind and a little grumpy, with a soft Scottish lilt. Recorded close, warm and clear.

inputs.label: Tik
inputs.value: A tiny, curious wind-up robot with a bright, slightly metallic and buzzy voice. Speaks fast and excitedly, like a child seeing snow for the first time.

inputs.label: Velvet
inputs.value: A breathy, low female late-night jazz announcer. Smooth, unhurried and intimate, as if smiling into a vintage ribbon microphone.

inputs.label: Nimbus
inputs.value: A sleepy giant made of clouds: an extremely deep, soft, slow voice, rumbling like distant thunder, with long yawns between words.

snippet:
d = requests.post("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-voice/design",
    headers={"xi-api-key": KEY},
    json={"voice_description": "An elderly lighthouse keeper with a gravelly voice…",
          "model_id": "eleven_ttv_v3", "text": SAMPLE}).json()
takes = d["previews"]  # three takes: audio_base_64 + generated_voice_id
